description: This file defines a utility object `StringUtils` in Kotlin, which provides methods for joining and splitting strings using linked lists. It acts as a wrapper around `JoinUtils` and `SplitUtils` utility methods.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: An object providing string manipulation utilities like join and split.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins elements of a LinkedList into a String using `JoinUtils.join`.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using `SplitUtils.split`.
